headline: Senior QA Engineer for Poker & Quantitative Systems
summary: Senior QA Engineer with 5 years of experience in test automation across international SaaS and telecom platforms. BSc in Mathematics, 10 years of poker experience, and hands-on testing across API, backend and E2E layers with Playwright and TypeScript, Cypress, REST Assured and Java, Karate and Python. Built a poker range-training product with production-style QA and a quantitative Python optimization model for CI. Targeting QA/SDET roles at the intersection of poker, AI and solver evaluation, game integrity and complex backend systems.
fit: 10 years playing poker, including Spin & Go, studying with GTO Wizard; strong working knowledge of EV, equity, pot odds, ranges, combinatorics, blockers and decision-making.
Mathematics background applied to optimization, combinatorial reasoning, edge cases and quantitative validation.
Built Spin Trainer, a preflop range-training product with server-side grading, player statistics and 80 reference ranges.

jobs.meta: Remote. Telecom OSS platform for EWE (Germany)
bullets: Design and execute testing for TM Forum-based service-order flows across add, modify, delete, suspend and reactivate operations in Jira and Xray.
Build API automation with Karate against TM Forum APIs, and created a one-click Postman smoke suite for post-deployment service checks.

jobs.meta: Remote. International cybersecurity SaaS, threat modeling
bullets: Built a Python MILP optimization model for CI sharding: 42% faster in a one-worker benchmark; modelling production workers showed 4 containers instead of 7 could be about 8% faster and 41% cheaper.
Led the testing strategy for a core Security Content module across backend, API and frontend layers.
Designed Playwright and TypeScript E2E automation for a combinatorial rules engine using Page Objects, API-backed setup and data factories.
Automated backend APIs with REST Assured and JUnit 5, including schema validation, negative cases and traceability; contributed to a TestCafe to Playwright migration that cut runtime by about 80%.
Moved client projects from primarily manual testing to scalable Cypress and JavaScript E2E automation.
Reported 500+ defects prioritized by product risk and business impact; validated data with SQL and coordinated releases with development.
Onboarded and mentored teammates on QA tooling and automation practices.

projects.title: Spin Trainer
projects.text: My own poker range trainer, from idea to release: React and Spring Boot. 145 API tests, 37 Playwright specs on mock and real backends, mutation testing; 8 real defects found.

projects.title: Solver Validation Lab
projects.text: Poker equity engine and a validator for solver strategy exports, with a regression diff between versions. 26 of 26 seeded defects caught.

projects.title: Real-Time Testbed
projects.text: WebSocket poker table tested for retries, reconnects, races, timers and server crashes with a chaos simulator. 17 of 17 seeded bugs caught.

projects.title: Game Integrity Lab
projects.text: Evaluation testbed for bot, RTA and collusion models on synthetic data: per-segment false positives and a regression gate. 11 of 11 seeded bugs caught.
